name: upload_model
description: Upload a trained model artifact from S3 to HuggingFace Hub.

name: hf_snapshot_download
description: Stage a HuggingFace model or small dataset snapshot into S3 and return a file manifest {s3_uri, repo_id, repo_type, revision, files:[{path,size_bytes,s3_key}]}. Use for model weights or small repos; very large datasets should go through prepare_eval_dataset + the Processing container instead.

s3_prefix.description: S3 key prefix destination, e.g. models/qwen3-4b

revision.description: Git revision (branch, tag, or commit SHA)

name: retrieve_dataset_metadata
description: Fetch a HuggingFace dataset's splits, column schema, and optional tiny sample rows (≤50) via the HuggingFace Datasets Server REST API. No parquet download, no Lambda disk IO — this is a pure metadata call. Use BEFORE submit_training_job or prepare_eval_dataset to resolve the correct train_split / test_split names (e.g. HuggingFaceH4/ultrachat_200k → train_sft/test_sft, not train/test) and to pick input_columns / expectation_columns / context_columns for the eval spec. Returns {dataset_name, split, requested_split, config, columns, available_splits, available_configs, records, count, card_excerpt, preview:true, preview_cap}.

dataset_name.description: HuggingFace dataset repo ID, e.g. PatronusAI/financebench

split.description: Dataset split to sample rows from (default: train). If the split doesn't exist, the server falls back to the first available split and returns both `requested_split` and `split` in the response so the agent can reconcile.

config.description: Optional dataset config / subset name. Defaults to the first config the Datasets Server reports (usually `default`).

columns.description: Restrict returned records (not the schema) to this subset of columns. The full column schema is always returned in `columns`.

max_rows.description: How many sample rows to include inline (default 0 = metadata only, 2 HTTP calls). Clamped server-side to 50. Set >0 only when you need to inspect actual values — schema discovery alone doesn't require it.

name: prepare_eval_dataset
description: Author an evaluation spec (JSON) describing how to load and reshape a HuggingFace dataset into the MLflow genai {inputs, expectations} record shape. Writes the spec to S3 and returns its s3_uri; the SageMaker Processing container (via submit_eval_job) reads the spec and materialises the dataset at job time. No dataset download happens here — this is intentional so any size dataset is supported. task_type selects the default column mapping (question_answering|rag|summarization|text_generation|classification); pass input_columns / expectation_columns / context_columns to override.

task_type.description: Evaluation task — picks default input/expectation column mappings

dataset_name.description: HuggingFace dataset repo ID, e.g. PatronusAI/financebench

input_columns.description: Override the default input column candidates for task_type

expectation_columns.description: Override the default expectation column candidates for task_type

context_columns.description: Column(s) that carry retrieved context for RAG tasks

max_rows.description: Optional cap on records materialised at eval time (0 means all rows)

out_s3_prefix.description: S3 prefix where the eval_spec.json is written (default: eval-specs/<dataset>)

source_schema.description: (R3) Source record shape. Optional — when omitted, the eval container infers from the dataset's column names (messages → chat, prompt+chosen+rejected → dpo, text → sft, multi-column → tabular-csv). Pass explicitly to get a handler-side refusal on unsupported target_schema pairs.

target_schema.description: (R3) Desired record shape after transformation. When omitted or equal to source_schema, no transformation runs. Supported pairs: chat→sft (flatten_messages), sft→chat (unflatten_to_messages), dpo→sft (drop_rejected). Unsupported pairs (chat→dpo, tabular-csv→anything) fail with a clear error before any S3 write.

name: update_model_card
description: Update or append to the README.md (model card) on a HuggingFace repo.

name: manage_tags
description: Add or remove tags on a HuggingFace repo.

remove.description: Remove listed tags instead of adding (default: false)
